senses.gloss: m. constr. (b. h.; פ׳ פֶּה opening of the mouth, point of attack, fault-finding; excuse for wrong-doing. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. II, Par. 2 שלא ליתן פ׳ פה למינין לרדות in order not to give heretics (believers in plurality) occasion for rebellion.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:9">Gen. R. s. 8</cite> <he>בכל מקום שאתה מוצא פ׳ פה וכ׳</he> wherever (in the Scriptural text) there is an opportunity for heretics (to find pluralistic allusions), you will find the refutation next to it.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:9">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="P01474"><he>נעשה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 1:26">Gen. I, 26</cite>) Moses said, Lord of the world, <he>מפני מה אתה נותן פ׳ פה למינים</he> why wilt thou furnish a point of attack to heretics? <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 20:8">Lev. R. s. 20</cite>; a. fr.
